Product:{\"sku\":\"7100106369\"}.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+
Product:{\"sku\":\"7100106369\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ is the most complete and up-to-date version of the game that redefined the modern roguelike genre. It delivers the most features, the most content, the most gameplay modes and the ultimate thrill of online play for up to four players.

You’ll Never Have to Go In All Alone

Isaac and his mother lived alone in a small house on a hill. Life was simple, and they were both happy. Until the day Isaac’s mom heard a voice from above, telling her that Isaac was to be sacrificed as an offering to prove her love and devotion. Trembling in fear, Isaac noticed a trap door hidden under the rug in his bedroom, so he flung open the hatch and escaped into the unknown depths below. With no way to defend himself, Isaac discovered that the creatures in the dungeons could be held at bay by his own free-flowing tears... and that the treasures lying around could be very useful.

Pray for Repentance and Be Reborn... Online

Since the original release of The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth in 2014, the combination of dungeon crawling, twin-stick shooter action and randomized replayability has made the Isaac series a landmark gaming experience for several generations of players. Repentance+ includes all the hundreds of additions and improvements that have been implemented since the Repentance DLC appeared in 2021, plus full-featured online play for up to four participants. Play online with friends, start or join a match with strangers... you can even jump into a "Quick Match" with online players chosen at random.

• Online play in all game modes, including daily runs and challenges
• Extensive filters for customizing preferences when hosting or joining online matches
• New “Item Information” option reveals functionality of items you’ve previously picked up
• New leaderboards for online play
• Over 700 different items to collect
• 34 unique playable characters
• More than 330 individual enemy types
• 120+ terrifying, deadly bosses and mini-bosses
• Multiple difficulty settings and game modes
• Bestiary to record enemy encounters
